description: Convert an Nx workspace's ESLint configs to use Flat Config.

eslintConfigFormat.description: The format of the generated ESLint flat config files.

keepExistingVersions.description: Keep the existing versions of any ESLint-related packages already declared in `package.json` instead of overwriting them. Only newly added packages are installed, at the versions for the ESLint major the workspace declares (v9 when it declares none).
